messages.content: API hygiene check: reply with exactly OK and do not call a tool.

function.name: patch_and_check
function.description: Apply a multi-file unified diff to the current repository and return validation feedback. The diff must use standard unified-diff format with 'a/' and 'b/' path prefixes. Paths are relative to the task root. Only existing, allowlisted source files may be edited — no new files, deletions, renames, or binary changes. All hunks must apply exactly. Returns: application status, public runtime-test results, and the complete mypy type-checker report.

patch.description: A multi-file unified diff in standard format. Paths use 'a/' and 'b/' prefixes and are relative to the task root. Example header: --- a/src/mod.py\n+++ b/src/mod.py
